The quarta via invokes a converse maximum-to-cause principle; the example does not justify that universal converse. A three-entity interpretation has one same-account edge with comparison and a changed-account edge without it; it witnesses formal non-implication, not metaphysical possibility. Unrestricted implies restricted, with no converse on this interpretation. No root theorem type or premise changes and no closure follows.
